title: A number that another Part Library entry has exactly is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location.
  • Create a part, part B, for this test at location B only, so its separate Part Library entry is one the test location does not stock.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Replace the Part Number with part B's number, typed exactly.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Wait 5 seconds.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  8. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  9. Replace the search text with part B's part number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Part Number shows part B's number.

Step 4:

  • Nothing is saved and the window stays open.
  • A red message reads "Part number" followed by part B's number and "already belongs to another part in the Part Library.", with a second, smaller line "Please try to resolve this."

Step 5:

  • The red message has gone on its own after about 3 seconds, and the window is still open.

Step 6:

  • The window closes.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • Part A's entry is listed with its own number, unchanged.

Step 9:

  • Part B's entry (stocked at location B) is listed, unchanged: there are still two entries.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-N1: “If another Part Library entry already has exactly the typed number, with the same characters and the same upper and lower case, the save is refused, the dialog stays open, and the system shows "Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library."”
  • Key Decisions: “A rename follows the same match rule as linking. A rename is refused only when another Part Library entry has exactly the typed number: the same characters, with the same upper and lower case.”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part number already belongs to another entry | "Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open”

From: Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026, written against PRD v22; re-shared by the QA lead on 27 Oct 2026, unchanged), read 27 Oct 2026

  • §1 Clarifications, Q2 S13-N1 rename refusal: “Exact (same characters and case), like create's link rule.”
